messages:
maya: heads-up I opened a small docs PR to clarify adapter-tagged variants + quantized fallback behavior in the model catalog. short explainer + JS/Python SDK snippets + a quick eval set. https://git.company/redwood/docs/pull/4210 :wave:
ravi: nice, link looks good. Is the fallback semantics spelled out (order, left-to-right)?
maya: yes — explicit line: fallback_policy is left-to-right; runtime picks first compatible variant available in the tier. added a tiny example to show the difference.
tanya: please add a one-line compatibility table for private runtimes < v1.8.0 (they skip adapters). we've seen support tickets about that.
maya: added a compatibility note and flagged for release notes.
olivia: can we soften wording on quality? say "aims to preserve intent" not "preserve semantics". folks misread that.
maya: changed wording to "aims to preserve intent but may alter phrasing/tokenization."
ravi: SDK snippets look good; add a CLI smoke example so infra folks can test without SDK.
maya: added CLI: `rwctl infer --model nebula3b+adapter:romulan-v1 --input "Summarize this" --max-tokens 128 --prefer-quant-fallback`
qa-bot: I ran a quick regression against nebula3b-int8 fallback on a small eval set — mean delta ~3.4% (within threshold). CI link in PR.
docs-ci-bot: PR 4210 docs build: success 
Preview: https://docs-preview.company/4210
maya: thanks all. I'll ping QE for a full cluster run and merge after green. :shipit:
